2 بدّد , inf. n. تَبْدِيدٌ, He separated, disunited, dispersed, or dissipated; (S, M, A, Mgh, L, K;) as also ↓ بَدَّ , aor.
بَدُ3َ , inf. n. بَدٌّ: (S, L:) or the latter has this meaning, and the former signifies he separated, disunited, dispersed, or dissipated, much. (Msb.) ―
-b2- He (a man) gave his equal share of the expenses for a journey. (IAar, T.) [See also 3.] ＝
-A2- He (a man) was, or became, weary, tired, or fatigued: (IAar, T, M, K:) or he drowsed, or slumbered, while sitting, without sleeping. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
